changes.description: For Black/African American high school seniors who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents and demonstrate academic achievement, leadership, service and financial need. Awards total $40,000 over four years; essays and recommendations are required.
changes.deadlineLabel: December 1, 2026 (recommendation deadline December 15)

changes.description: Thirteen $25,000 awards recognize students for academic success, community service and financial need. Includes a one-year leadership development and mentoring program; review the sponsor application for full eligibility.
changes.deadlineLabel: November 3, 2026

changes.description: A graduate-study scholarship for eligible college students committed to public-service careers. Applicants must be nominated by their institution; check campus nomination deadlines before the national deadline.
changes.deadlineLabel: February 2, 2027, 11:59 p.m. in your time zone; campus deadlines may be earlier

changes.description: Need-based awards of up to $25,000 for high school juniors who have overcome adversity and demonstrate leadership, service and academic commitment. Check the sponsor for the next application cycle and detailed eligibility; high school seniors should review its other programs.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check sponsor for the next junior-year application cycle

changes.name: Hispanic Scholarship Fund Scholar Program
changes.description: Merit-selected HSF Scholars receive support services and may receive a cash award based on need and available funding. Hispanic-heritage students must meet citizenship/residency, GPA and full-time enrollment requirements; a Scholar designation does not guarantee a cash award.
changes.deadlineLabel: 2026 application closed; check sponsor for the next cycle

changes.name: American Indian College Fund Scholarships
changes.description: Scholarships for American Indian and Alaska Native students in certificate, undergraduate or graduate programs at tribal colleges and universities or accredited nonprofit schools. One annual application covers multiple opportunities; eligibility and funding vary.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check sponsor for current application and priority dates

changes.description: UNCF administers a range of scholarships, fellowships and other student opportunities. Each program has its own school, major, eligibility, essay and deadline requirements; use the official opportunities portal to find a match.
changes.deadlineLabel: Varies by individual scholarship

changes.name: Hagan Scholarship
changes.description: A renewable scholarship with funding determined by educational costs and other aid, plus required workshops and student responsibilities. Review the sponsor’s current academic, income, enrollment and work requirements before applying.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check sponsor for current application cycle

changes.description: College and trade-school scholarships, educational assistance and career support for military children who lost a parent in the line of duty. The program is joining Tunnel to Towers and states that scholarship processing continues; contact the sponsor to confirm eligibility and funding.
changes.deadlineLabel: Contact sponsor about enrollment and funding

changes.description: For eligible low-income Dreamer students attending a participating in-state or online Partner College. Current rules include U.S. arrival before age 16 and before November 1, 2021; international students and temporary nonimmigrant statuses are ineligible. Review all immigration, residency, GPA and enrollment criteria directly with the sponsor.
changes.amount: Up to $18,000 associate / $36,000 bachelor, plus possible stipends
changes.deadlineLabel: Check sponsor for current National Scholarship cycle

changes.description: For legal U.S. residents age 18+ attending an accredited U.S. college or university. Submit a 500–800 word essay about community involvement, plus required photos and enrollment documentation; three awards in this cycle.
changes.deadlineLabel: November 30, 2026, 11:59 p.m. Central

changes.description: For eligible current or retired participating-union members, spouses and dependent children. Applicants must meet membership and enrollment rules; essays weigh heavily in selection. Awards are one-time, but students may reapply in later years.
changes.deadlineLabel: January 31, 2027 (confirm time in sponsor rules)

changes.description: Achievement-based awards recognizing leadership and service among eligible students in their final year of high school. The program selects 150 students for $20,000 awards; current citizenship/residency, GPA and school requirements apply.
changes.deadlineLabel: 2027 application is closed; check sponsor for next cycle

changes.description: A highly selective, last-dollar scholarship for outstanding high school seniors from low-income households. Check the official application for current eligibility, funding coverage, required materials and deadlines.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check sponsor for current application rules and dates

changes.description: Connects high-achieving high school seniors from low-income backgrounds with partner colleges and full four-year Match Scholarships. Review citizenship, academic and financial criteria and the binding Match process before ranking colleges.
changes.deadlineLabel: 2026 Match applicants have been selected as Finalists; check sponsor for next entry cycle

changes.description: Scholarships for eligible high school seniors, Burger King employees and employee families pursuing postsecondary college or vocational/technical education. Awards and criteria vary by application track; check the administrator for current requirements.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check sponsor for current application cycle

changes.name: Imagine America Career College Scholarships
changes.description: Tuition discounts/grants at participating career colleges through separate high-school, adult-learner and military programs. Check your chosen school and program requirements; this is tuition assistance at partner schools rather than unrestricted cash.
changes.deadlineLabel: Varies by school and program

changes.description: The old individual scholarship page redirects to FC2S’s redesigned website, which now describes strategic workforce and educational investments through CommunityNow. A current public individual scholarship application could not be verified.
changes.deadlineLabel: Current scholarship application unverified

changes.name: Jeannette Rankin National Scholar Grant
changes.description: Unrestricted, nontuition grants for eligible students age 35+ who self-identify and present as women, pursuing technical/vocational education, a first associate degree or first bachelor degree at an accredited nonprofit U.S. institution. Review income and other sponsor criteria.
changes.deadlineLabel: February 12, 2027; application and recommendation deadline

changes.name: DAR Pittenger American History Scholarship
changes.description: For a graduating high school senior pursuing an undergraduate degree with at least 24 credit hours in American history or American government. The$2,000 award may be renewed for up to four years under GPA and transcript requirements; see sponsor for details.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check DAR scholarship portal for current cycle

changes.description: A current national college-scholarship program and application could not be verified from the inherited URL. Specific state or land-grant university 4-H programs should be reviewed separately.
changes.deadlineLabel: Current application unverified

changes.name: Sallie$2,000 No Essay Scholarship
changes.description: For legal residents of the 50 U.S. states, D.C. or U.S. territories age 16+ who meet the specified college-student, high-school-junior/senior or parent eligibility. Monthly sweepstakes; no essay required. Review official rules before entering.
changes.deadlineLabel: Monthly entry periods; see sponsor for current deadline

changes.description: A no-essay drawing for eligible high school, college and graduate students or those planning enrollment within 12 months. Entrants age 13–17 require parental consent/supervision; citizenship or valid-visa and other official-rule restrictions apply.
changes.deadlineLabel: Monthly sweepstakes periods; confirm current rules

changes.name: Appily Easy Money Scholarship
changes.description: A monthly no-essay scholarship for eligible U.S. students age 13+ who create a free Appily account and plan postsecondary enrollment. Complete the profile and entry requirements in the official rules; one winner is selected each month.
changes.deadlineLabel: Monthly entry periods

changes.description: For people ages 13–25 living in the U.S. or U.S. citizens abroad who complete an eligible community-service action and report back. No essay, GPA or recommendation requirement; each action has its own location, rules, award and deadline.
changes.deadlineLabel: Varies by eligible action

changes.description: Art and writing recognition and scholarship opportunities for eligible teen entrants. Portfolio scholarships for high school seniors submitting six works can reach$12,500; other awards and regional rules differ. Review current grade, age and submission requirements.
changes.deadlineLabel: Varies by region and category

changes.description: A national visual, literary and performing arts competition for eligible students in grades 10–12 or ages 15–18, with U.S. citizenship, residency or taxable-income eligibility requirements. Winners receive cash awards and career/mentorship support.
changes.deadlineLabel: Current application closed; next 2028 application opens summer 2027

changes.description: Scholarships for students in eligible engineering, technology and related programs. Undergraduate tracks require an eligible ABET-accredited program; year-of-study, GPA, graduate-major and regional requirements differ. Recommendations are required; check the relevant application.
changes.deadlineLabel: Collegiate/graduate: Dec 1, 2026–Feb 1, 2027; first-year: Feb 8–Mar 31, 2027

changes.description: One application covers multiple scholarship opportunities for senior FFA members in high school and FFA alumni in college, pursuing trade certificates, two-year or four-year programs. Individual sponsors set additional eligibility criteria.
changes.deadlineLabel: Applications open November 1, 2026; due January 14, 2027

changes.description: For eligible students in grades 9–12. Submit an original audio essay on the current patriotic theme with an entry form through a participating local VFW Post. National, state and local awards vary.
changes.deadlineLabel: October 31, 2026, midnight; submit through your participating VFW Post

changes.description: For eligible new applicants ages 16–26 pursuing postsecondary education. Submit either a 30-second–2-minute video or a 250–500-word essay about passion, community and impact. No GPA or test-score requirement; financial need is considered for new 2027 applicants.
changes.deadlineLabel: January 5, 2027, 5 p.m. Pacific

changes.name: American Legion Legacy Scholarship
changes.description: Need-based support for eligible children of U.S. servicemembers who died on active duty on or after September 11, 2001, or post-9/11 veterans with a VA combined disability rating of at least 50%. Review documentation and other aid requirements directly with the sponsor.
changes.amount: Up to $20,000 for children of fallen / $5,000 for children of disabled veterans
changes.deadlineLabel: Last posted 2026 application closed; check sponsor for next cycle

changes.name: Boys & Girls Clubs Youth of the Year Scholarships
changes.description: Scholarships for participants advancing through Boys & Girls Clubs Youth of the Year recognition. State winners receive $2,500, regional winners $20,000 and the National Youth of the Year $50,000. Ask your Club about participation and its selection process.
changes.deadlineLabel: Contact your Club about its selection timeline

changes.name: AICPA Foundation Legacy Scholarships
changes.description: Awards supporting eligible accounting students pursuing CPA careers, with separate Future CPAs, first-generation/public accounting and two-year-transfer opportunities. GPA, citizenship/residency, enrollment and other rules differ; one application can cover eligible Legacy awards.
changes.deadlineLabel: Check the relevant Legacy scholarship for current dates
